passages.title: Chaya Mushka Schneersohn
passages.snippet: Chaya Mushka Schneersohn was the daughter of Rabbi Dovber Schneuri, the second Rebbe of the Chabad Hasidic movement, and the wife of Rabbi Menachem Mendel Schneersohn the third Rebbe.

passages.title: Derech Mitzvosecha
passages.snippet: Derech Mitzvosecha, also titled Sefer Hamitzvos (), is an interpretive work on the Jewish commandments authored by Rabbi Menachem Mendel Schneersohn (1789–1866), the third Rebbe of the Chabad Hasidic movement. The work is considered a fundamental text of Chabad philosophy.

passages.title: Bernd Hüttemann
passages.snippet: Bernd Hüttemann (born December 8, 1970 in Paderborn) is Vice President of the European Movement International and Secretary General of the European Movement Germany.

passages.title: European Movement International
passages.snippet: The European Movement International is a lobbying association that coordinates the efforts of associations and national councils with the goal of promoting European integration, and disseminating information about it.

passages.title: European Journal of Human Genetics
passages.snippet: The European Journal of Human Genetics is a monthly peer-reviewed scientific journal published by the Nature Publishing Group on behalf of the European Society of Human Genetics. It covers all aspects of human genetics.

passages.title: The Journal of Antibiotics
passages.snippet: The Journal of Antibiotics is a peer-reviewed medical journal published by the Nature Publishing Group for the Japan Antibiotics Research Association

passages.title: Iker Muniain
passages.snippet: Due to his style of play and stature, he was dubbed "the Spanish Messi" by the media. He has spent all of his professional career with Athletic Bilbao after debuting in 2009 as their youngest player in a competitive match, making over 380 appearances for the club and reaching the finals of the Copa del Rey and Europa League in 2012.

passages.title: My Fair Lady (film)
passages.snippet: The head of CBS, William S. Paley, put up the money for the original Broadway production in exchange for the rights to the cast album (through Columbia Records). When Warner bought the film rights in February 1962 for the then - unprecedented sum of $5 million, it was agreed that the rights to the film would revert to CBS seven years following release.

gold_posthoc.note: Same-component rates on the raw graph are structural connectivity, including connectivity caused by generic hubs. They are not a measure of evidence-group correctness.

formulas.shared_idf_sum: sum of idf over shared entities whose df<=pair_cap
formulas.weighted_jaccard: shared_idf_sum / (idf(A)+idf(B)-shared_idf_sum), A and B exclude entities with df>pair_cap
formulas.pair_cap_meaning: Entities above the cap are omitted from stored candidate pairs and from IDF/Jaccard scores. They remain in the union-find hub-filter experiments.
